# Fixture provenance

- `alpha.avif`: original 64×32 RGBA test pattern created for this project (red 240, green 30, blue 60; alpha 0/128/255 in vertical regions). Encoded with libheif 1.23.5: `heif-enc -A -L source.png -o alpha.avif`.
- `layers.psd`, `layers-psd.png`: `test/read/layers/src.psd`, `canvas.png` from https://github.com/Agamnentzar/ag-psd/tree/387049670cb89b88fb8fe1b7c01aeacf98dd2e3b .
- `layers.psb`, `layers-psb.png`: `test/read/psb/src.psb`, `canvas.png` from the same pinned revision.
- Upstream Photoshop fixtures are MIT licensed; see LICENSE-ag-psd.
- All remaining samples are generated by tests/formats.rs, including independent PSD/PSB raw/RLE/ZIP layouts, 8/16/32-bit data, animated GIF, multi-page 16-bit TIFF, SVG alpha, and HDR exposure patterns.

For the public repository, PSD/PSB non-rendering resources containing XMP history/document identifiers, IPTC/EXIF dates, version information, print settings and embedded thumbnails were removed. Pixel data, layers and ICC profiles are preserved. The original expected PNGs remain unchanged and are used for full-pixel regression comparison.
